overview_description.description: Stilt offers financial services for immigrants, visa holders, and the underserved. Stilt uses proprietary and public data sources to predict the creditworthiness of immigrants with limited or zero credit history. The company's lending platform offers short term loans to expatriates and non-citizens with limited credit history at lower interest rates, enabling them to access capital and receive credit.

product.name: Personal Loans

product.description: Student loans and refinancing options for international students in the U.S. without requiring a Social Security Number.

product.name: EB-5 Visa Loan Program
